status: Exploratory two-frequency fits on a selected primary branch.

method.coordinates: Published dRAs and dDEs in arcseconds; O-C columns unused.
method.time: Recorded calendar-date differences in days; no time-scale or A8 conversion.
method.model: Two frequencies; separate offset and two sine/cosine pairs per coordinate.
method.weights: Each pair/calendar date has total weight 1 in full data; retained weights unchanged in sensitivity run.
method.score: 1 minus weighted two-coordinate residual sum of squares / constant-model sum of squares.
method.sampling_window: Squared modulus of weighted mean exp(2*pi*i*f*t).
method.branch_selection: Highest-scoring V1 candidate with period >2 days for each pair/case.
method.search: Scan second frequency with primary fixed; locally refine both frequencies for five separated candidates.
method.local_bounds: Each frequency within 0.45/(pair span) of its seed, clipped to original search range.
method.scope: Other primary alias branches are not searched in this run.
method.residual_reduction: Relative to the selected single-frequency baseline, not a significance estimate.

scope: Independent archive analysis; no Core20 authority input.

omit_line640.note: Only pair 24 changes; other pair results reused.
